senses.gloss: (denom. of מַשְׁכּוֹן) to take a pledge; to seize, levy.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 81b:13">B. Mets. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מִשְׁכְּנוֹ בשעת הלואתו</he> he made him give a pledge at the time when the loan was transacted; <he>מ׳ שלא בשעת וכ׳</he> he seized it (through court proceedings) after the transaction of the loan. Ib. 113ᵇ <he>שליח ב״ד שבא למַשְׁכְּנוֹ</he> when the court messenger comes to seize his goods.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:3">Shek. I, 3</cite> <he>את מי מְמַשְׁכְּנִין</he> against whom was seizure (for the contribution of the half-Shekel) executed?—Y. ib. II, beg. 46ᶜ <he>מכיון שב״ד ראויין למַשְכֵּן ולא מִישְׁכְּנוּ</he> since the court had a right to seize and did not do so (because the claim was satisfied with another man’s money).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> (play on <he>משכני</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:4">ib.</cite>) <he>מַשְׁכֵּינְנִי אחריך נרוצה</he> execute levy against me (take my sanctuary, v. <cite ref="M02900"><he>מַשְׁכּוֹן</he></cite>), yet after thee we run.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:4">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>אני נוטל</he> … <he>ומְמַשְׁכְּנוֹ בעדם</he> I take a righteous man from them and seize him for their guilt; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00017"><he>מְמוּשְׁכָּן</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְמוּשְׁכָּנִים</he>, <he>מְמוּשְׁכָּנִין</he>. Y. Shek. l. c. <he>אין תורמין … ולא על הממ׳</he> in distributing the Temple contributions we do not take into account that which is being collected (and has not yet come in) or that which is to be obtained by seizure.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73b:1">B. Mets. 73ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02906">next w.</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51:7">Ex. R. s. 51</cite>, beg. <he>שנ׳ שתי פעמים וכ׳</he> it (the sanctuary) was twice seized for their sins, v. <cite ref="M02900"><he>מַשְׁכּוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:4">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>; Tanḥ. Vayakh. 9 <he>יהא המשכן מִתְמַשְׁכֵּן עליהם</he>, v. <cite ref="M02900"><he>מַשְׁכּוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ויהיו מִתְמַשְׁכְּנִין וכ׳</he> and they (the righteous) will be seized &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:16">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>המשכן והמקדש יִתְמַשְׁכְּנוּ וכ׳</he> the Tabernacle and the Temple shall be seized &c.; a. fr.
